For losing weight with medical help: the two approved weekly shots, what they cost, and the copies sold online.

Two peptide drugs are FDA approved for weight management and need a prescription. Compounded copies and newer molecules sold online are not approved.

  • Semaglutide (Wegovy) · weekly shot for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

    A weekly shot on prescription, for obesity or overweight with a health problem. It cuts appetite.

    A weekly shot that cuts appetite; about 15 % body weight lost on average in trials. 1

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription; online clinics prescribe after a visit.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Tirzepatide (Zepbound) · weekly shot for weight lossFDA approvedon prescription

    A weekly shot on prescription, for the same use as Wegovy. It had a larger average loss in trials.

    A weekly shot, same idea, larger average loss in trials.

    FDA approved for weight management.

    Prescription.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Compounded semaglutide or tirzepatide · pharmacy-made shotNot FDA approved; pharmacy-madeon prescription

    Shots mixed by a pharmacy, sold by online clinics on prescription, often cheaper. Not FDA approved.

    Pharmacy-made copies sold by online clinics, often cheaper. Not checked by the FDA batch by batch.

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

    Prescription through the clinic.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Retatrutide · experimental shot, still in trialsNot approved; still in trialsresearch use only

    A newer shot still in trials, not approved for anyone. Sold online only in research-use vials.
